pages.title: Florida Police Chiefs Association Endorses Chief Financial Officer Jimmy Patronis for Reelection - Chief Financial Officer Jimmy Patronis
pages.text:
## Florida Police Chiefs Association Endorses Chief Financial Officer Jimmy Patronis for Reelection
Tallahassee, Fla. – The Florida Police Chiefs Association (FPCA) today endorsed Jimmy Patronis for reelection as Chief Financial Officer of the State of Florida.
“On behalf of the Florida Police Chiefs Association, we are honored to endorse Chief Financial Officer Jimmy Patronis for reelection,” said FPCA president and Daytona Beach Shores Public Safety Department Director Stephan Dembinsky. “CFO Patronis has been a vocal and resolute champion of protecting and defending law enforcement officers as they serve the people of Florida.”
FPCA 1st vice-president and Fellsmere Police Department Chief Keith Touchberry said, “CFO Patronis has consistently made the health and welfare of first responders a priority all the time, not just when it’s politically convenient, and we know we can count on his continued leadership.”
FPCA 2nd vice-president and Clermont Police Department Chief Charles “Chuck” Broadway said, “CFO Patronis has always led from the front during times of tragedy like major hurricanes and the Surfside building collapse, delivering the support first responders need to do their job.”
About the Florida Police Chiefs Association
The Florida Police Chiefs Association (FPCA) is the nation’s pre-eminent law enforcement professional association, speaking for more than 1000 of Florida’s top law enforcement executives, and providing guidance and leadership for the future of law enforcement and our communities. The FPCA serves municipal, airport, college and university, and tribal police departments, as well as private businesses and security ﬁrms and federal, state and county law enforcement agencies across every region of the state. For more information about the FPCA, please visit www.fpca.com.

pages.title: Fraternal Order of Police Endorse CFO Jimmy Patronis for Reelection - Chief Financial Officer Jimmy Patronis
pages.text:
## Fraternal Order of Police Endorse CFO Jimmy Patronis for Reelection
Fraternal Order of Police (FOP) endorses CFO and State Fire Marshal Jimmy Patronis for reelection. CFO Patronis has helped pass legislation protecting first responders and has been outspoken about backing the blue.
President of Fraternal Order of Police, Steve Zona said, “It is our pleasure to announce our endorsement of Jimmy Patronis for re-election as CFO in November. He’s a man who wholeheartedly supports police and has a passion to advocate for our officers. When many are looking to defund us, we know Jimmy will never waiver in his resounding support for police presence in our Florida communities. He understands justice, he understands safety, he understands sacrifice and he understands us. Jimmy has more than proven that he is the man for the job, and we just want to emphasize and acknowledge that with our endorsement here today.”
CFO Patronis said, “Thank you for the honor of this incredible endorsement. One of the best parts of my job is being able to work with the men and women who make up the thin blue line of our country. The stories of bravery and sacrifice that you all have are a true testament to the importance of your job. I am committed to making sure that you are never taken for granted. I ‘back the blue’ because I know that you have the backs of every one of our Florida communities. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for all you do and the trust you show in this endorsement.”

pages.title: Jimmy Patronis to Continue Strong Record of Constituent Services in Congress, Pledges to Reinstate District Office in Escambia - Jimmy Patronis for Congress
pages.text:
Endorsed By President Trump
January 14, 2025
## Jimmy Patronis to Continue Strong Record of Constituent Services in Congress, Pledges to Reinstate District Office in Escambia
[PENSACOLA / 1-14-25] – Today, Florida Chief Financial Officer Jimmy Patronis announced his commitment to reopening a district office for Congressional District 1 in Escambia County.
In office, CFO Patronis has made it his top priority to serve constituents and he looks forward to continuing that in Congress. As a member of Florida’s Cabinet, CFO Patronis led operations assisting thousands of Floridians with insurance claims, connecting policy holders with insurance companies, seeing their issue is resolved. CFO Patronis plans to compliment Senator Rick Scott, voted best congressional office for constituent services, to deliver results for Floridians.
CFO Jimmy Patronis said , “I am a people person, that is why I am running for Congress, to assist and serve Floridians in the Panhandle. For those who enjoy the traditional atmosphere of an in person meeting, I am pledging to reopen a district office in Pensacola. It makes sense for the largest city in the Panhandle to have a dedicated location where they can go to get help and have their voices heard. Florida is known in Washington for its constituent services and I will be the best advocate for the Panhandle in Congress.”
The district office for CD-1 in Escambia county was closed in 2023. In addition to opening an Escambia office, CFO Patronis will prioritize mobile office hours and visiting Floridians in the district who may not be able to get to an office in person. In Congress, CFO Patronis will work with President Trump and America First patriots to fix issues constituents are facing on the front end.
In addition to being endorsed by President Trump, Senator Rick Scott endorsed Jimmy Patronis in the CD-1 race. The Special Primary Election Day is scheduled for January 28, 2025 and the Special General Election is slated for April 1, 2025. For more information on Jimmy Patronis visit https://joinjimmy.com/.
